items.title: Snowflake CEO explains how software companies can survive in the AI era
items.summary: Snowflake (SNOW) CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy speaks with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi about the company's rising stock price and why it is an "era of consolidation" for the software industry as it deals with the effects of AI.

items.title: Agentforce ARR Hits $1.5B: Can It Boost Salesforce's Revenue Growth?
items.summary: CRM's Agentforce ARR tops $1.5B as AI adoption surges, but its scale still points to steady rather than explosive revenue acceleration.

items.title: Salesforce is Nearly Fully Priced: Why Bulls Say This is Just the Beginning
items.summary: Salesforce bulls are pointing to an AI monetization curve that is bending sharply upward, but the bears have real ammunition too, and with Dreamforce and Investor Day arriving next week, the stock sits at a crossroads where the next few weeks could settle the argument for years.

items.title: What Qualtrics’ CEO Says Software Companies Must Possess
items.summary: The “SaaSpocalypse” of earlier this year—based on the notion that powerful AI models will soon make companies selling software-as-a-service obsolete—turned out to be a phantom.  The latest example comes from Qualtrics, which later today will announce its new XM Data and AI platform.

items.summary: Clients bought SPCX, NVDA, MU, INTC, and GOOGL, while net selling PLTR, MSFT, NOW, CRM, and ORCL.
